stories.excerpt: The former UK prime minister told a Solana conference he backs blockchain but still doubts Bitcoin, months after calling it a Ponzi.
stories.summaryZh: 前英国首相在一场Solana会议中表示支持区块链技术，但仍对比特币持怀疑态度，这与他此前称比特币为庞氏骗局的说法相呼应。
